name: K P R Mill Ltd
about: K.P.R. Mill is engaged in one of the largest vertically integrated apparel manufacturing Companies in India. The Company produces Yarn, Knitted Fabric, Readymade Garments and Wind power.[1]
keyPoints:
Products
The company produces a wide range of products such as yarn, fabric, garments, sugar, molasses & ethanol. The company also has a presence in the automobile industry & power generation industry through its subsidiaries. [1] [2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.1%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.21%
